Render a compact blue high-box delivery truck, dark blue cab and blue cargo body, same modest scale and orientation, with exactly two clearly visible adult drivers side by side behind the windshield. Keep the truck grounded on the same road. Use Image 2 only for vehicle shape, paint, cabin layout and two-driver cue; ignore its background. Keep the hand-painted northern winter storybook language. No extra vehicle, no extra people, no road changes, no new buildings, no text, no invented lettering, no logo, no collage, no photorealism, no toy or low-poly render.
